class.name: CubismExpressionDescriptor
class.brief_description: Imported expression identity, fades and ordered parameters.
class.description: Data-only expression resource retained in [member CubismModelResource.expressions]. Runtime expressions have independently owned SDK state. This resource does not apply parameters or play an expression. Setters emit [signal Resource.changed] without making arbitrary values valid; the parser and runtime validate the descriptor.

members.member: Expression fade-in time. -1 is the uninitialized/absent override sentinel; parsing resolves source defaults.
Expression fade-out time. -1 is the uninitialized/absent override sentinel; parsing resolves source defaults.
Declared expression name used for runtime selection.
Ordered [CubismExpressionParameter] entries. Repeated IDs retain source ordering.
